productsData.title: Alter Engine
productsData.description: Turn one objective into a clear sequence of work. Review the plan, approve important actions and inspect the result.
productsData.detailTitle: From one objective to reviewable work.
productsData.detailExplanation: Alter Engine identifies what needs to be completed, proposes the steps and keeps approval points clear before actions run.

detailRows.label: What you provide

detailRows.label: What the Engine does

detailRows.label: What you receive

productsData.detailExplanation: Provide your users with reliable, step-by-step automation that pauses for their approval and returns a fully transparent execution record.

engineStages.heading: Begin with the result.
engineStages.explanation: Describe what needs to be completed in ordinary language. Alter Engine identifies the objective and asks only for context that is genuinely missing.

engineStages.heading: See the path before the work begins.
engineStages.explanation: The Engine turns the objective into a sequence of steps, dependencies and decisions that can be reviewed.

engineStages.heading: Keep important decisions with the right person.
engineStages.explanation: Actions involving permission, judgement or risk pause until someone approves them or changes the plan.

engineStages.heading: Follow the work as it moves.
engineStages.explanation: Approved steps run in order. Completed, current and waiting actions remain visible throughout the process.

engineStages.heading: Review the result, not just the activity.
engineStages.explanation: Alter Engine compares what came back with the original objective. Weak or failed steps return for revision, retry or human judgement.
engineStages.typedLine: The result is ready to review.
